unmapped_findings: Measured chemical composition of the 0.04Nb steel strip (Table 1): Mn 12.82, Al 9.12, Cr 2.99, C 1.40, Nb 0.039, Fe Bal. (wt%).
For both the 0.02Nb and 0.04Nb steels, the aging treatment at 723 K for 6 h could result in good comprehensive mechanical properties.

Extended aging at 723 K does not markedly alter the yield strength of Nb-containing steels: κ-carbide precipitation strengthening intensifies while dislocation strengthening diminishes (grain boundary strengthening remains relatively unchanged).
Compared to 0.02Nb steels, the size of NbC particles in 0.04Nb steels significantly increases with the prolongation of aging period.
